summary: The response is strong. It tells the user not to run the wiki sequence yet, explains that nova-compute down does not prove the host is dead, and covers the local-delete risk and the record-only nature of reset-state. It requires fencing before --down, prefers restarting nova-compute, gives read-only checks first, and states the scope of the lab validation. Verification covers Nova, Neutron (ports), Cinder (attachments), placement and the hypervisor. There are three minor weaknesses. The \"or definitely not coming back\" wording slightly loosens the fencing condition. A sub-step ordering note in option 2 is placed oddly. Risk classes per option are only implied.
